messages.content: 你能計算我進行的科學實驗中空氣在恆壓下的熱容量嗎？我有一個容積為2.5立方公尺的容器，並能保持溫度在300開氏度。我將在更高的溫度350開氏度重複這個實驗，接下來在更低的容積1.5立方公尺下一樣重複這個實驗。我在所有這些實驗中都使用空氣。你能提供這三種不同條件下的熱容量嗎？

function.name: calc_heat_capacity
function.description: Calculate the heat capacity at constant pressure of air using its temperature and volume. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

temp.description: The temperature of the gas in Kelvin.

volume.description: The volume of the gas in m^3. This is a float type value.

gas.description: Type of gas, with air as default.

message.reasoning:
We need to calculate heat capacity at constant pressure of air given temp and volume. But heat capacity at constant pressure (Cp) is independent of volume for ideal gas? For ideal gas, Cp depends only on temperature (and composition). For air, Cp ~ 1005 J/(kg·K) at 300 K. But we can compute using ideal gas law: PV = nRT. For constant pressure, Cp per mole is about 29.1 J/(mol·K). But they want heat capacity of the gas in the container? Might be total heat capacity of the amount of air present. So we need to compute mass or moles from volume and temperature using ideal gas law. Then multiply by Cp per mole or per kg.

We have function calc_heat_capacity(temp, volume, gas?) which presumably calculates heat capacity at constant pressure. We need to call it thrice: 300 K, 2.5 m^3; 350 K, 2.5 m^3; 300 K, 1.5 m^3? Wait they said: first experiment at 300 K, volume 2.5 m^3. Then repeat at higher temp 350 K. Then lower volume 1.5 m^3 same conditions? They said "I will repeat this experiment at higher temperature 350 K, then at lower volume 1.5 m^3 next repeat." So we have three conditions: (300 K, 2.5 m^3), (350 K, 2.5 m^3), (300 K, 1.5 m^3). They want heat capacities.

We need to call function with temp in Kelvin, volume in m^3. Provide gas default "air". So we call function thrice.
